verses.text: Masanil heb' sat yaj t'a heb' yetisraelal winhaj Josué chi', ix smolb'ej heb' winh t'a Siquem, haton heb' ichamtak winak, heb' juez yet' heb' yajal yaji, ix och heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb': --Icha tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal: Ha t'a peka', a heb' he mam eyicham, haton winhaj Taré yet' chawanh yuninal, haton winhaj Abraham yet' winhaj Nacor, ek'nak kajan heb' t'a yichanhb'at ha' niwan Éufrates, yalnak sb'a heb' t'a komon Dios.

Hata' wik'nakkot winhaj Abraham chi', wak'annakek' kajan winh t'a yol yik lum Canaán tik. Wak'annakpax jun yuninal winh, haton winhaj Isaac, te q'uib'nakchaanh sb'isul yinhtilal winhaj Abraham chi' yuj winh yuninal chi'.

Wak'annak chawanh yuninal winhaj Isaac chi', haton winhaj Jacob yet' winhaj Esaú. Wak'annak lum tzalkixtak yik Seir t'a winhaj Esaú chi'. Haxo winhaj Jacob yet' heb' yuninal b'atnakkan kajan heb' t'a Egipto.

Niwan tiempo ek'nak heb' ta', slajwi chi' in chekannakb'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a Egipto chi', wak'annakkot juntzanh niwak yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' aj Egipto chi', masanto k'ochnak stiempoal yik wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham chi' ta'.
Ayik yelnakkot heb' chi' ta', kotnak tzak'an heb' aj Egipto chi' t'a spatik heb' yet' skarruaje yet' nok' chej masanto t'a sti' ha' Chakchak Mar.

Yuj chi' in yawtej heb' he mam eyicham chi': Ha inxo wak'och jun k'ik' k'inal t'a skal heb' yet' heb' tzak'an yuj heb' chi', wak'annak spoj sb'a ha' mar t'a yichanh heb', palta wak'anxi yil-laj sb'a ha', smukchajnakkanb'at heb' aj Egipto chi' yuj ha'. Ha ex tik, eyilnak wal sik'lab'il tas wutejnak heb' chi'. Najtil ek'nakpax heb' he mam eyicham chi' t'a tzinan lu'um,

masanto ex wik'kot yet' heb' t'a lum yik heb' amorreo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán tik. Ix yak' owal heb' heyet'ok, palta a in ix wak'och heb' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ix eyak'an ganar heb', ix eyikejkan sluum heb'.

Ha winhaj Balac yuninal winhaj Zipor, sreyal heb' moabita, snib'ej winh yak'nak owal heyet'ok. Yuj chi' schekb'at yik'umal winhaj Balaam winh, haton winh yuninal winhaj Beor, yuj ex skatab'an winh yalan winh.
Palta maj ex in cha katab'aj yuj winhaj Balaam chi', yuj chi' haxo wach' lolonel yalnakkan winh t'a eyib'anh. Icha chi' aj ex in kolankanel t'a yol sk'ab' winh.

Slajwi chi' ex ek'ta t'a yol ha' Jordán, ex jawi t'a Jericó. Ha heb' ay t'a Jericó chi' yet' heb' amorreo, heb' ferezeo, heb' kananeo, heb' hitita, heb' gergeseo, heb' heweo yet' heb' jebuseo, ix yak' owal heb' heyet'ok, palta a inxo ix wak'och heb' t'a yol he k'ab'.
Eyak'nak ganar chawanh sreyal heb' amorreo, palta manh yujok k'een eyespada yet' he jul-lab', palta a in wak'nakb'at jun niwan xiwelal t'a yib'anh heb', yuj chi' el heb' t'ayex.

Ha in ix wak' lum he lum b'aj ex aj tik, manhok ex ix eyawej tas awab'il t'a sat lu'um. Ix wak'an he pat b'aj tzex kajnaji, palta manhok ex ix he b'ok'ei. Ha tiknaik, wach'xo eyaji, tze lo sat te' uwa yet' sat te' oliwo, manhok ex eyawejnak te', xchi Jehová chi'.

--Yuj masanil juntzanh tik ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a yol he sat, tzeyak'anem he b'a t'ay t'a smasanil he k'ool. Ik'ekel komon Dios t'a he kal, icha juntzanh b'aj yak'nakem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham t'a yichanhb'at ha' Éufrates yet' t'a Egipto, anhejokab' t'a Jehová b'aj tzex och ejmelal.

Palta tato malaj he gana tzeyal he b'a t'a Jehová chi' jun, sik'lejek mach b'aj tzeyal he b'a, tato ha t'a juntzanh Dios b'aj yalnak sb'a heb' ko mam kicham t'a yichanhb'at ha' Éufrates chi', mato t'a sdiosal heb' amorreo kajan t'a tik, palta a inxo tik yet' masanil heb' kajan wet' t'a yol in pat, ha t'a Jehová ol kal ko b'a, xchi winhaj Josué chi'.
Ix tak'wi heb' anima chi' icha tik: --Malaj b'ak'uinh ol kaktejkan Jehová ko Diosal yik skalan ko b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'.

Yujto a Jehová chi' ik'annak onh elta t'a Egipto b'aj ochnak heb' ko mam kicham chekab'wumal. A' b'oannak juntzanh tas satub'tak yilji t'a kichanh. Onh stanhwani, onh skolanpaxi ayik onh kot t'a yoltak b'e yet' onh ek'ta t'a skal juntzanh chonhab'.

Ha Jehová ix ik'anel masanil juntzanh chonhab' t'a kichanh, icha ix yutej heb' amorreo kajan t'a tik. Ha yuj masanil juntzanh tastak ix sk'ulej chi', yuj chi' anhej t'ay ol kak'em ko b'a, yujto ko Diosal, xchi heb' anima chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Josué chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Manh ol yal-laj eyak'anem he b'a t'a Jehová yujto max techaj yuj ayik syilanoch he chukal, yujto ste kot yowal sk'ool tato tzex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios, manh jab'ok syak' niwank'olal he mul chi'.
Wach'chom tzijtum tastak wach' ix sb'o Jehová t'ayonh, palta tato tze patikejeli, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios tzeyal he b'a, ol kot yowal sk'ool t'a eyib'anh, ol ex sataneli, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi masanil heb' anima chi' icha tik: --Manh ol kak'emlaj ko b'a t'a juntzanh chi', anhej t'a Jehová ol kak'em ko b'a, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: --Hanheja' ex tzeyak'och he b'a testigoal to anhej t'a Jehová ol eyak'em he b'a, anhej t'ay ol ex och ejmelal, xchi winh. --Yeltoni, a onh ton skala', xchi heb' anima chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: --Tato icha chi' an, ik'ekel masanil komon Dios t'a he kal, tzeyak'anem he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Ha onh tik yet' wal smasanil ko k'ool skalani to ha t'a Jehová ko Diosal ol kak'em ko b'a, ol ko k'anab'ajan masanil tas syala', xchi heb'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix sb'o jun trato winhaj Josué yet' heb' yetisraelal t'a Siquem, ix yak'ankan juntzanh cheknab'il winh yet' juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al t'a heb'.
Ix stz'ib'ankan juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winh b'alchajkot jun k'een niwan k'een, ix yak'ankanoch k'een winh t'a yich jun te' mach' t'a slak'anil skajnub' Jehová.

Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' ayek' chi': --Ha t'a yichanh jun k'een tik tz'alchajkan tas ix yal Jehová t'ayonh. Ayik ol kilan k'een, ol ko naankoti to manh ol ko patikejkanel-laj ko Diosal, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to smeltzaj heb' t'a smakb'en junjun.
Ixlajwi chi', ix cham winhaj Josué schekab' Jehová, haton winh yuninal winhaj Nun, 110 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.
Ix mukji winh t'a Timnat-sera, t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, t'a snorteal switzal Gaas.
Ha heb' chonhab' israel chi', ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová heb' yakb'an pitzanto winhaj Josué yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ilannak masanil tas sk'ulejnak Jehová t'a heb'.

Ix mukjipax sb'akil winhaj José yik'nakkot heb' israel chi' t'a Egipto. Ha t'a Siquem ix mukji, t'a lum smannak winhaj Jacob t'a heb' yuninal winhaj Hamor smam winhaj Siquem. 100 plata yak'nak lum winhaj Jacob chi'. Ha jun lugar chi' ochnakkan yikok heb' yinhtilal José.

Ix champax winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Aarón. Ha t'a jun tzalan ix mukchaj winh, t'a sat slum winhaj Finees, haton winh yuninal winh, haton lum ak'b'il smakb'enok winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín.
